records.title: Treatment of Aeroembolism by the Application of Local Pressure
records.locator: No. 3 pp. 4–6, counts pp. 4–5 and signed byline p. 6

observations.outcome_window: At initial assessment of relief. One of 20 upgraded from partial to complete relief after 15 minutes.
observations.note: Selected people who reported extremity bends during chamber exposure. The author describes a seven-person preliminary set and a 20-person subsequent set within the 27-person total. The same 20 are classified again for recurrence after pressure release. Untreated outcomes, the number exposed, standardized follow-up and diagnostic adjudication are unavailable.
